content.value_statement: Paid campaigns fail when tracking events, UTMs, or dedup rules are inconsistent. This skill turns GA4 exports and manual tests into a launch checklist.
actual_capabilities: Builds a pass, fail, or needs-input pre-flight checklist for conversion tracking.
Checks UTM consistency against GA4 Traffic-acquisition source and medium exports.
Defines a UTM naming convention and conversion-event specification for paid campaigns.
Flags cross-platform dedup and attribution-window gaps before launch.
Routes unresolved reconciliation work to the appropriate attribution workflow.
limitations: It does not score ROAS vetoes or the full account audit.
It depends on user-provided GA4, ecommerce, and campaign exports.
It does not require direct Google Ads, Meta, or tag-manager API access.
It flags modeled iOS and offline gaps, but does not resolve them automatically.

use_cases.title: Pre-Launch Tracking Review
use_cases.description: Check event firing, UTMs, dedup rules, and attribution windows before a campaign scales.

use_cases.title: Analytics Export Cleanup
use_cases.description: Use GA4 exports to find source, medium, campaign, and conversion naming problems.

use_cases.title: Measurement Handoff
use_cases.description: Create a tracking spec that agencies and internal teams can follow during launch.

prompt_templates.title: Run Basic QA
prompt_templates.prompt: QA my conversion tracking before launch. Platforms are Google and Meta. I will provide GA4 Conversions and Traffic-acquisition exports.

prompt_templates.title: Build Tracking Spec
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a UTM scheme and conversion-event spec for this campaign. Include event names, values, currencies, and dedup IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Find Measurement Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: My ad platforms and GA4 disagree. Review these exports for UTM, dedup, attribution-window, and modeled-gap issues.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Auditor Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Complete the tracking pre-flight, mark every item pass or needs-input, and prepare the handoff for account scoring.

output_examples.input: A marketer shares GA4 exports and asks if tracking is ready before scaling Meta and Google campaigns.
output: Purchase event fires, but lead value is missing.
Google uses cpc while Meta uses paid_social consistently.
Dedup source is not documented, so attribution reconciliation is needs-input.

output_examples.input: A growth lead asks for a UTM and conversion-event plan for a new paid campaign.
output: Recommended UTM fields use lowercase source, medium, campaign, content, and term values.
Purchase maps to purchase with transaction_id as the dedup key.
Lead maps to generate_lead with lead_id as the dedup key.
The team should run one manual test conversion before launch.

output_examples.input: An analyst reports that Meta, Google, and GA4 order counts do not match.
output: The skill flags attribution-window mismatch and possible platform overlap.
It confirms the pre-flight rule and routes full order-ID reconciliation to attribution review.
The launch decision remains needs-input until the source of truth is named.

best_practices: Provide fresh GA4 Conversions and Traffic-acquisition exports before starting the review.
Run one manual conversion test and include the expected event name and value.
Keep UTM values lowercase, consistent, and free of personal data.
anti_patterns: Do not mark missing exports as pass.
Do not trust platform-reported conversions as the only source of truth.
Do not embed emails, names, order IDs, or personal data in UTM fields.

faq.question: Does this skill require ad platform API access?
faq.answer: No. It can work from user-provided GA4, ecommerce, and campaign exports.

faq.question: Can it score ROAS or account quality?
faq.answer: No. It prepares the measurement signal before a separate account audit scores performance.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide GA4 Conversions, GA4 Traffic-acquisition source and medium exports, platform names, and one manual test result.

faq.question: Does it fix tag-manager settings directly?
faq.answer: No. It identifies tracking gaps and gives a clear fix list for the responsible team.

faq.question: How does it handle iOS or modeled conversions?
faq.answer: It flags modeled or partial conversion gaps and explains whether they affect launch readiness.

faq.question: Can it create a reusable tracking standard?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates a UTM naming convention and conversion-event spec for future campaign launches.
